LinkLayer._read_persistence_revision_anchor treats an awaitable result as an invalid revision without cancelling/closing it, while _advance_persistence_revision_anchor ignores an awaitable return entirely. Accidentally async anchors leak never-awaited coroutines and may report success after only scheduling side effects. new_value: {"notes":"Security review broadened this boundary: anchor read/advance execute under LinkLayer._security_lock with no transition/reentry guard. Same-thread recursive save, a spawned thread joining on the Link lock, or callback state mutation can deadlock or split serialized/runtime state. Fix must move hooks outside internal locks under guarded snapshot/CAS semantics, reject reentry, and fail closed after ambiguous writes; add cross-thread join and mutation tests."}
